title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
english: A Ukrainian diver has been detained in Croatia due to his alleged involvement in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. German prosecutors claim the man helped plant explosives on the undersea infrastructure using a rented yacht. This arrest follows previous legal efforts in Poland and Italy regarding other suspects connected to the sabotage, as authorities seek to hold individuals accountable for the major energy infrastructure attack.
amharic: የኖርድ ስትሪም የጋዝ ቧንቧ መስመርን በቦምብ በማፈንዳት የተጠረጠረ አንድ የዩክሬን ዜጋ በክሮሺያ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የጀርመን አቃቤ ህጎች እንደሚሉት፣ ግለሰቡ በ2022 የባህር ውስጥ መስመሮቹ ላይ ፈንጂዎችን በመትከል ተሳትፏል። ይህ እስር ከዚህ ቀደም በፖላንድ እና በኢጣሊያ ከተያዙ ሌሎች ተጠርጣሪዎች ጋር በተያያዘ የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ለጉዳቱ ተጠያቂ የሆኑ ሰዎችን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ እየሰሩ ነው።

title: Houthis threaten wider escalation against Saudi Arabia
english: Yemen's Houthi rebels have announced a new strategy involving maritime blockades and military strikes against Saudi Arabia to counter current restrictions. The group claims to have already targeted numerous oil vessels and military sites, warning that any further Saudi aggression will lead to a broader conflict. They are demanding that Riyadh end its military involvement, withdraw foreign troops, and allow Yemen to control its own natural resources.

title: Prosecutors Charge Seven Alleging Amhara Bank’s Credit Controls Bend for One Borrower
english: Federal prosecutors have charged five former Amhara Bank executives, along with Zemera Investment Group and its manager, for allegedly mismanaging bank funds. The group is accused of bypassing standard credit procedures to provide improper financial benefits to the investment firm, resulting in a loss of over 137 million Birr. The case centers on the illegal handling of import finance documents and the conversion of liabilities into unauthorized loans without proper collateral or risk analysis.

oromo: Abbaan alangaa federaalaa qondaaltota baankii Amaaraa duraanii shan fi garee invastimantii Zemeraa dabalatee namoota torba irratti himata banee jira. title: Israel numbers Palestinian detainee foreheads: What we know
english: Israeli soldiers recently marked a Palestinian detainee with a number on his forehead during a military operation in the West Bank town of Qabatiya. The Israeli army confirmed this action occurred, claiming it was part of a security raid targeting individuals suspected of planning violent acts. This incident has drawn significant criticism, as released detainees described the practice as a form of psychological intimidation and terror.

title: Second Ukrainian national arrested over 2022 Nord Stream pipeline blast
english: A second Ukrainian national has been arrested in Croatia and faces extradition to Germany for his alleged role in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions. German prosecutors identify the man as a trained diver who worked under the direction of an ex-army officer already facing charges for the same incident. This investigation aims to clarify the sabotage that damaged key gas supply routes between Russia and Europe.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ 2022 በኖርድ ስትሪም የጋዝ ቧንቧ መስመር ላይ የተፈጸመውን የፍንዳታ ጥቃት ተከትሎ ሁለተኛው የዩክሬን ዜጋ በክሮኤሺያ ተይዟል። ተጠርጣሪው ለጀርመን አቃቤ ህግ እንደሚሰጥ የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ከዚህ ቀደም በዚሁ ጉዳይ በተከሰሰው የቀድሞ የዩክሬን ወታደራዊ ኦፊሰር መሪነት ተሳትፎ እንደነበረው ተጠቁሟል። ጀርመን በሩሲያ እና በአውሮፓ መካከል የነበረውን የጋዝ መስመር ያወደመውን ይህን የሽብር ድርጊት ለማጣራት ምርመራዋን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።

title: Premier League 2026-27 form guide: Title race, prediction, players to watch
english: Following their successful title win last season, Arsenal enters the 2026-27 Premier League campaign as the team to beat by strengthening their already solid roster with new signings like Bruno Guimaraes. While Manchester City faces a transition period following Pep Guardiola's departure, other major clubs like Manchester United, Liverpool, and Chelsea are reorganizing to challenge for the championship. The upcoming season is expected to be highly competitive as these top teams adjust to new management and tactical shifts.

title: Israel’s Ben Gvir boasts of planned execution facility for Palestinian prisoners
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has announced the construction of a facility specifically designed to execute Palestinian prisoners through hanging. This project aligns with a controversial law passed by the Knesset that permits the death penalty for Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks. The plan includes viewing areas for victims' families, a move that has drawn sharp international criticism for being discriminatory and dehumanizing.

title: UK jury fails to convict activists over direct action at Israeli arms factory
english: A jury in the UK was unable to reach a verdict for eight activists accused of participating in a protest at an Israeli-linked arms factory in Bristol. The defendants were charged with property damage and violent behavior, although none of them actually entered the facility during the demonstration. Prosecutors are currently considering whether to pursue a new trial for the unresolved charges.

title: Foreign interference is real - but the UK should look beyond the usual culprits
english: The UK government has officially identified foreign interference as a major national security threat, primarily focusing on rivals like Russia and China. However, recent reviews suggest that influence campaigns also originate from allied nations and private groups, including actors linked to the United States and Israel. Critics argue that the government ignores these sources of political influence while strictly monitoring traditional adversaries, leading to calls for a more balanced approach to investigating external pressure on British democracy.

Mootummaan gareewwan kanneen duubatti dhiisee diinota isaa qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuu isaa qaawwa jiru jedhamee kan qeequ yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa alaa irratti qorannoo haqa qabeessa ta'e akka taasisu gaafatamaniiru.

title: 'Playing with fire': Israel's Syria strike tests Turkey after Mecca defence pact
english: Israel recently conducted airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur military base in Syria, shortly after Turkey signed a new defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. While Israel claims the move was to prevent a security breach involving Turkish forces, Turkish officials dismiss the attack as a political tactic by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The incident has increased tensions, as Turkey denies having a military presence at the site and criticizes Israel for failing to communicate through established safety channels.

Israa'el tarkaanfichii kan fudhatame loltoonni Turkey bakka sana akka hin qabanneef jecha akka ta'e dubbattee jirti; garuu mootummaan Turkey haleellaan kun mala siyaasaa kan muummicha ministeeraa Benjamin Netanyahu ta'uu ibsuun balaaleeffatteetti. title: US seeking ‘honourable exit’ as regional influence fades, says Iran
english: The speaker of Iran's parliament claims that foreign influence in the Middle East is weakening as a new regional order emerges. He attributed this change to the sacrifice of two commanders killed by the US in 2020. According to him, the United States is now attempting to withdraw from the region while Israel's regional ambitions are failing.

english: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho stated that his team does not require newly signed Barcelona player Rodri, despite admitting the club previously attempted to recruit him. english: The delivery of humanitarian aid in Gaza is severely hindered by a critical shortage of functional vehicles and spare parts due to the ongoing conflict. Many trucks have been destroyed or damaged, and those still operating struggle with lack of fuel and mechanical supplies. Furthermore, drivers face immense risks while navigating through damaged infrastructure and blockades, making it nearly impossible to distribute essential supplies to those in need.

title: Palestinian factions explore broad alliance for November elections
english: Major Palestinian political groups, led by Hamas and including various breakaway factions, are currently negotiating the formation of a unified electoral coalition ahead of the upcoming November legislative elections. This move aims to challenge President Mahmoud Abbas's Fatah party, which intends to run in the vote independently. Despite significant obstacles posed by ongoing regional conflict and political tensions, the factions view these historic polls as an essential exercise of their democratic rights.

Rakkoolee naannichatti jiran hunda keessa darbuudhaan, gareewwan kunneen filannoon kun mirga isaanii kan dimookiraasii akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Israeli army orders criminal investigation into killing of Palestinian girl Hind Rajab in Gaza
english: The Israeli military has launched a criminal investigation into the 2024 killing of five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza. This move follows reports that the young girl and her family were killed by Israeli fire while attempting to escape. An ambulance crew sent to rescue Hind was also struck and killed during the incident, which the military is now investigating due to failures in movement coordination.

title: Dozens killed after gold mine collapse in Central African Republic
english: A tragic gold mine collapse in the Central African Republic near the Cameroon border has resulted in the deaths of at least 30 people, with officials warning the final toll may be even higher. Rescue teams and local volunteers are currently searching the site to locate those still trapped under the debris. These types of accidents occur frequently in the region due to a lack of safety regulations and oversight in small-scale mining operations.

title: UAE trade embargo could shut Iran’s key economic escape route: Here’s why
english: The United Arab Emirates has imposed an indefinite trade and financial embargo on Iran following accusations that Iranian forces launched ballistic missiles into Emirati territory. Although Iran denies these claims and labels them as a provocation, analysts believe the ban will significantly impact Tehran because it relies on the UAE for vital imports and financial connectivity. This development marks a major escalation in regional tensions, potentially cutting off a critical economic lifeline for the Iranian government.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች የኢራን ኃይሎች በግዛታቸው ላይ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን ተኩሰዋል በሚል ክስ በኢራን ላይ ያልተወሰነ ጊዜ የንግድ እና የገንዘብ ማዕቀብ ጥለዋል። ኢራን ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ ድርጊቱን ቅስቀሳ ብትልም፣ ኢራን ለቁልፍ የገቢ ዕቃዎች እና የፋይናንስ መዳረሻዎች በኢምሬቶች ላይ የተመሰረተች በመሆኗ ማዕቀቡ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስባት ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ይህ ውሳኔ በክልሉ ውስጥ ያለውን ውጥረት በእጅጉ የሚያባብስ ሲሆን ለኢራን መንግሥት አስፈላጊ የሆነውን የኢኮኖሚ መስመር ሊዘጋው ይችላል።
oromo: Emirates Araba Gamtoomni humnoonni Iraan kombiiwwan bala'ina guddaa qaban gara biyya isaanii gadi lakkisaniiru jechuun, daldalaa fi waliigaltee maallaqa irratti Iran irratti uggura cimaa kaa'eera. title: In Ukraine, forcible military recruitment efforts escalate into violence
english: Ukraine is facing growing controversy over its aggressive military mobilization tactics, often referred to as 'busification,' where men are forcibly detained on the streets and taken to recruitment centers. This practice has become increasingly common and abusive, leading to reports of corruption and violent confrontations between civilians and officers. Many individuals, including those with health conditions, are being conscripted against their will, sparking significant public concern regarding the methods used to replenish the front lines.

title: Pakistan challenges top court order to move Imran Khan to private hospital
english: The Pakistani government has formally requested a review of a Supreme Court decision that ordered former Prime Minister Imran Khan to be transferred to a private hospital for medical care. Officials argue that the court bypassed standard legal protocols and that prisoners should receive treatment at public facilities instead. While the court previously authorized specialized care and increased family communication for the 73-year-old leader, the government contends that these directives exceed normal prison regulations.

title: Palestinians condemn Israeli step to advance illegal E1 settlement plan
english: The Palestinian Authority has strongly criticized Israel's decision to move forward with a controversial settlement plan known as E1, which involves building over 1,200 new housing units in the occupied West Bank. Critics warn that this project will physically divide the West Bank and cut off East Jerusalem from Palestinian areas, effectively ending hopes for a two-state solution. By connecting existing settlements, the expansion seeks to consolidate Israeli control over the region and further marginalize the Palestinian population.

oromo: Mootummaan Paalastayinii Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa West Baankii keessatti mana jireenyaa 1,200 oliin ijaaruuf karoorri 'E1' jedhamu akka itti fufu murteessuu ishee balaaleffateera. title: China’s Unitree soars in market debut as investors bet on humanoid robots
english: Chinese robotics firm Unitree Robotics experienced a massive surge during its Shanghai stock market debut, with share prices jumping by over 600 percent. The company is now recognized as a major leader in the humanoid robotics industry, having successfully sold thousands of units globally. This successful listing highlights significant investor confidence in China's growing ability to produce advanced, commercially viable human-like robots.
amharic: የቻይናው የሮቦቲክስ ኩባንያ ዩኒትሪ በሻንጋይ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ባደረገው የመጀመሪያ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ የአክሲዮን ዋጋው ከ600 በመቶ በላይ በማደግ ከፍተኛ ተቀባይነት አግኝቷል። ኩባንያው በዓለም ዙሪያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰብአዊ መልክ ያላቸው ሮቦቶችን በመሸጥ በዘርፉ ግንባር ቀደም መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። ይህ የገበያ ስኬት ባለሀብቶች ቻይና የላቁ እና ለንግድ አገልግሎት የሚውሉ ሮቦቶችን በማምረት ረገድ ያላትን አቅም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እንደሚያምኑበት ያሳያል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teknooloojii Chaayinaa Unitree Robotics gabaa akshinii Shaanghaay irratti yeroo jalqabaaf dhiyaatetti gatiin akshinii isaa dhibbeentaa 600 ol dabaleera. Dhaabbatichi hanga ammaatti addunyaa maratti roobootii nama fakkaatan kumaan lakkaa'aman gurguruun damee kana keessatti hogganaa ta'uu isaa mirkaneesseera. Milkaa'inni gabaa kun, abdii guddaa invastaroonni dandeettii Chaayinaa kan roobootii ammayyaa oomishuuf qabdu irratti qaban kan calaqqisiisuudha.

title: Angelique Kidjo makes history with Hollywood walk of fame star
english: Renowned Beninese singer Angelique Kidjo has become the first Black African artist to be honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. This recognition celebrates her impressive 40-year career in music and her significant contributions to fostering global cultural exchange. The five-time Grammy Award winner was acknowledged for her dedication to bridging communities through her artistic work.
amharic: የቤኒኑ የሙዚቃ ኮከብ አንጀሊክ kidjo በሆሊውድ የእግር ጉዞ ኮከብ (Hollywood Walk of Fame) ላይ ኮከብ የተቀበለች የመጀመሪያዋ ጥቁር አፍሪካዊት አርቲስት በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርታለች። ይህ ክብር የአርባ ዓመት የሙዚቃ ጉዞዋን እና በሙዚቃ አማካይነት ባህሎችን በማቀራረብ ያበረከተችውን አስተዋጽኦ ያመላክታል። አምስት ጊዜ የግራሚ ሽልማትን ያገኘችው አርቲስቷ ለሙዚቃ ስራዎቿ ከፍተኛ እውቅና ተሰጥቷታል።
oromo: Weellistuun beekamtuu biyya Beenin Anjelik Kijo, Hollywood Walk of Fame irratti urjii argachuun seenaa hojjettee jirti. Ispoortii ykn aartii kana irratti urjii kanaan kan badhaafamte, artistii Afrikaa gurraattii jalqabaa taateetti. Badhaasni kun guddina hojii ishee waggoota afurtamaa fi muuziqaan aadaalee addunyaa walitti fiduuf tattaaffii gooteef kan kennamedha.

title: After three years apart, a Gaza father returns to his wife - and six death certificates
english: After being separated from his family for nearly three years due to border closures and his detention, Ahmed al-Siqali has finally returned to Gaza. He suffered through long-term displacement and imprisonment, only to return home to the tragic news that six of his children were killed in an Israeli airstrike in late 2023. He now carries their death certificates, mourning the loss of the children he was working to support before the war began.
amharic: አህመድ አል-ሲቃሊ ድንበር በመዘጋቱ እና በእስር በመቆየቱ ለሦስት ዓመታት ያህል ከቤተሰቡ ተለይቶ ከቆየ በኋላ ወደ ጋዛ ተመልሷል። ረጅም ጊዜ የፈጀ መፈናቀልንና እስርን ካሳለፈ በኋላ፣ ወደ ቤቱ ሲመለስ ስድስት ልጆቹ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 መጨረሻ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት መገደላቸውን በመስማት በከፍተኛ ሀዘን ላይ ይገኛል። አሁን የልጆቹን ሞት ማረጋገጫ ወረቀቶች በእጁ ይዞ፣ ጦርነቱ ከመጀመሩ በፊት ለወደፊታቸው ሲጥር የነበረውን ልጆቹን በማጣቱ ጥልቅ ሐዘን ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Ahmed al-Siqali erga waggaa sadii guutuu cufiinsa daangaa fi hidhaan maatii isaa irraa adda ba'ee booda gara Gaazaatti deebi'eera. Godaansaa fi hidhaa dheeraa erga dabarseen booda, gara manaatti yeroo deebi'u ijoolleen isaa jahan dhuma bara 2023 haleellaa qilleensa irraa Israa'elidhaan ajjeefamuu isaanii hubateera. Amma waraqaa ragaa du'aa ijoollee isaa qabatee, waraanni osoo hin jalqabin dura guddina isaaniif hojjetaa ture sana dhabuu isaatti gadda guddaa keessa jira.

title: Iraq seeks special status for oil exports through Strait of Hormuz
english: The Iraqi parliament speaker has requested special protections for his country's oil shipments as they travel through the Strait of Hormuz. During a meeting in Baghdad with his Iranian counterpart, he expressed concerns about the safety of this vital maritime route amidst rising regional instability. This move underscores Iraq's vulnerability, as a significant portion of its oil exports relies on this path to reach global markets.
amharic: የኢራቅ ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ የሀገሪቱን የነዳጅ ምርቶች በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ሲጓጓዙ ልዩ ጥበቃ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል። በባግዳድ ከኢራን አቻቸው ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ በቀጠናው እየጨመረ የመጣው አለመረጋጋት ለነዳጅ መጓጓዣ መንገዱ ደህንነት ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የኢራቅ የነዳጅ ኤክስፖርት በአብዛኛው በዚህ የባህር መስመር ላይ የተመሰረተ በመሆኑ፣ ለሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚ ደህንነት ያለውን ወሳኝነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraaq, oomisha boba'aa biyyattii galaana Hormuz keessa yeroo darbuutti eegumsi addaa akka taasifamuuf gaafataniiru. Bagdaaditti hoggantoota Iraan waliin marii taasisaniin, walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa boba'aan gara gabaa addunyaatti ittiin darbuuf yaaddoo ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kunis, oomishni boba'aa Iraaq hedduun daandii galaana kana irratti waan hirkatuuf, nageenya boba'aa ishee eeguuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Humanitarianism is not collapsing. It is being traded and compromised
english: International humanitarian principles are currently being undermined as governments prioritize political interests over universal laws. This shift has turned the protection of civilians and aid workers into a bargaining chip rather than a non-negotiable obligation. Consequently, impunity is rising and attacks on humanitarian personnel have surged, creating a dangerous environment for those providing essential aid.
amharic: መንግስታት ከዓለም አቀፍ ህግጋት ይልቅ የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ ጥቅም በማስቀደማቸው ዓለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት መርሆዎች እየተሸረሸሩ ነው። የሲቪሎች እና የረድኤት ሰራተኞች ደህንነት እንደ ግዴታ ከመታየት ይልቅ ለድርድር የሚቀርብ የፖለቲካ መሳሪያ ሆኗል። በዚህም ምክንያት ተጠያቂነት የሌለው ድርጊት እየተስፋፋ ሲሆን በረድኤት ሰራተኞች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Mootummoonni seera idil-addunyaa irratti faayidaa siyaasaa isaanii dursuu irraan kan ka'e, sirni namummaa fi gargaarsaa akka laafatu ta'eera. Eegumsi siivilootaa fi hojjettoota gargaarsaa dirqama idil-addunyaa ta'uu irraa gara meeshaa siyaasaatti jijjiirameera. Kanaanis, seera cabsuun babal'atee hojjettoonni gargaarsaa miidhaan gara jabinaa irra ga'uun isaanii dabaleera.

title: ‘Tit for tat’: Why is Trump cozying up to North Korea’s Kim Jong Un again?
english: President Trump is seeking to restart diplomatic talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, recently scaling back military drills with South Korea in a gesture of goodwill. Analysts believe this move is a strategic attempt to boost his political profile ahead of upcoming elections while also pressuring Seoul for greater cooperation on other global issues. By balancing these relationships, Trump is using a transactional approach to secure domestic political gains and leverage his alliances.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን እንደገና ለመጀመር እየሞከሩ ሲሆን፣ ለዚህም እንደ መነሻ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር የሚያደርጉትን ወታደራዊ ልምምድ ቀንሰዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚገልጹት ይህ አካሄድ በምርጫ ወቅት የፖለቲካ ተቀባይነትን ለማግኘት እና በሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮች ላይ ደቡብ ኮሪያ በበለጠ እንድትተባበር ግፊት ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። ትራምፕ በዚህ የግብይት ዓይነት ዲፕሎማሲ ተጠቅመው የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ ትርፍ ለማስገኘት እና ጥምረቶቻቸውን እንደ መጠቀሚያ እየተጠቀሙበት ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp hogganaa Koriyaa Kaabaa Kim Jong Un waliin hariiroo diippiloomaasii irra deebi'anii jalqabuuf yaalaa jiru, kanaafis akka mallattoo gaariitti leenjii waraanaa Koriyaa Kibbaa waliin taasisan hir'isaniiru. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun filannoo dhiyaate dursee sadarkaa siyaasummaa isaanii ol kaasuuf fi dhimmoota biroo irratti Koriyaan Kibbaa akka isaan waliin hojjattu dhiibbaa gochuuf kan yaadame dha. Traamp tooftaa diippiloomaasii gabaa fakkaatu kanaan fayyadamuun, faayidaa siyaasaa ofii isaanii fi hariiroo biyyoota biraa itti fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
english: Authorities in Nevada have discovered human remains at Lake Mead after visitors spotted bones along the shoreline. The incident follows a severe, long-term drought that has caused the water levels in the nation's largest reservoir to reach record lows. Investigations are currently ongoing to identify the remains as the receding water continues to reveal items previously hidden underwater.
amharic: በኔቫዳ በሚገኘው የሊክ ሚድ ግድብ የውኃ መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመቀነሱ የሰው አጽም መገኘቱን ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግኝት የተከሰተው በክልሉ በተከሰተው ድርቅ ምክንያት የውኃው መጠን ከወትሮው ዝቅተኛ በመሆኑ ነው። በአሁኑ ሰዓት የህግ አስከባሪ አካላት ጉዳዩን እያጣሩ ሲሆን፣ የወረደው የውኃ መጠን ከዚህ ቀደም በውኃ ውስጥ የነበሩ ነገሮች እንዲጋለጡ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni naannoo Nevaadaa, sadarkaan bishaan haroo 'Lake Mead' gadi bu'uu isaatiin walqabatee lafeen namaa bakka sanatti argamuu isaa beeksisaniiru. Hir'inni bishaanii kun kan uumame goginsa cimaa waggoota dheeraaf tureen yoo ta'u, kunis lafeewwan yeroo dheeraaf bishaan jala turan akka mul'atan taasiseera. Poolisiin naannichaa qorannoo isaa itti fufaa jira.

title: Top India court allows passive euthanasia, but few aware of ‘living wills’
english: Although India's top court has legalized passive euthanasia, most citizens remain uninformed about the legal process for creating 'living wills' to manage end-of-life care. Many families of terminally ill patients struggle to access palliative support or understand how to advocate for their loved ones' dignity when medical treatments are no longer effective. Consequently, these families often face severe distress and confusion due to a lack of institutional guidance and awareness regarding terminal care options.
amharic: የህንድ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት በተዘዋዋሪ መንገድ ለሚፈጸም የሞት ፍቃድ (passive euthanasia) እውቅና ቢሰጥም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ዜጎች ህይወታቸው አልፎ ህክምና በማይጠቅምበት ጊዜ ስለሚወሰዱ ውሳኔዎች (living wills) በቂ ግንዛቤ የላቸውም። ተርሚናል በሆኑ ህመሞች የተያዙ ታካሚ ቤተሰቦች ተገቢውን የህመም ማስታገሻ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ወይም የሚወዷቸውን ሰዎች ክብር ለመጠበቅ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው ይቸገራሉ። በዚህም ምክንያት ተቋማዊ መረጃ ባለመኖሩ ቤተሰቦች ከፍተኛ የጭንቀት እና የመደናገር ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይወድቃሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Hindii biyyattii keessatti namoonni lubbuun isaanii daangaa irra gahe akka du'an hayyamuuf (passive euthanasia) seera baasee kan jiru ta'us, lammiileen hedduun waa'ee 'living wills' ykn fedhii du'aa duraa irratti hubannoo gahaa hin qaban. Maatiin dhukkubsattoota fayyuu hin dandeenye hedduun, tajaajila dhukkubbiin itti salphatu argachuuf ykn yeroo qorichi hin hojjennetti kabajamanii du'uuf maal gochuu akka qaban hin beekan. Dhabamuu odeeffannoo fi gorsa gahaa irraa kan ka'e, maatiin dhukkubsattootaa kun yaaddoo fi wal-dadhabbiin guddaa keessa galu.

title: NATO responds to alleged report that Iran considered targeting US forces in Europe
english: NATO has affirmed its commitment to protecting its member states following reports that Iran might target American military bases in Europe in response to potential US aggression. Alliance officials emphasized that their defense systems are highly capable, citing successful past instances where they neutralized threats from Iranian missiles. The organization remains prepared to take all required measures to ensure the security of its members.
amharic: ኢራን በአውሮፓ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ልትሰነዝር እንደምትችል በወጡ ዘገባዎች ተከትሎ፣ ኔቶ የአባል ሀገራቱን ለመጠበቅ ዝግጁ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የድርጅቱ አመራሮች ቀደም ሲል ከኢራን የተተኮሱ ሚሳይሎችን በመከላከል አቅማቸውን እንዳሳዩ በመግለጽ፣ አባል ሀገራቱን ከማንኛውም ስጋት ለመከላከል አስፈላጊውን እርምጃ ሁሉ እንደሚወስዱ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Iraan weerara Ameerikaa jala madaquun buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kanneen Awurooppaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa raawwachuu dandeessi jedhamee gabaasamee booda, NATO biyyoota miseensa isaa ittisuuf qophiidha jedhe. Hoggantoonni gamtaa kanaa, kanaan dura rakkoolee fagootti gahuu danda'an ittisuu keessatti dandeettii isaanii agarsiisaniiru; akkasumas miseensota isaanii eeguuf tarkaanfii kamiyyuu fudhachuuf akka qophaayan ibsaniiru.

title: US envoy says Israeli attack risked direct confrontation with Turkey
english: A US envoy has warned that a recent Israeli airstrike on a Syrian airbase nearly caused a military conflict with Turkey. Because Turkish forces were not notified of the operation, they could have mistaken the Israeli jets for a threat and launched their own aircraft in response. Although the situation did not escalate into a fight, officials expressed significant concern over the danger posed by the lack of communication.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማት በቅርቡ እስራኤል በሶሪያ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የፈፀመችው ጥቃት ከቱርክ ጋር ወታደራዊ ግጭት ሊፈጥር እንደነበር አስጠንቅቀዋል። ቱርክ ስለ ጥቃቱ ቀድሞ ማሳወቂያ ስላልተሰጣት፣ የእስራኤልን የጦር አውሮፕላኖች እንደ ስጋት በመቁጠር የራሷን ጄቶች ለማስነሳት ተገዳ ሊሆን ይችል ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ግጭቱ ባይቀጥልም፣ ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት የፈጠረውን የደህንነት ስጋት በእጅጉ ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Hojjetan mootummaa Ameerikaa tokko akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin Israa’el buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa irratti fudhatte waraana kallattii biyyattii fi Turkii gidduutti kaasuu danda’ee ture. Turkii tarkaanfichaan dura waan hin beekneef, xiyyaarota Israa’el akka diinaatti ilaaluun of ittisuuf xiyyaarota ishee kaasuuf dirqamtee turte. Haalli kun gara walitti bu’iinsaatti kan hin jijjiiramne ta’us, qaamoleen kun walhubannoo dhabuun kun balaa guddaa akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Permanently damaged her’: Israel’s starvation of Gaza leaves children stunted
english: Six-year-old Amira Rashid from Gaza is suffering from severe malnutrition due to the ongoing conflict and lack of food access. Her physical and mental development has been permanently impaired, preventing her from starting school as planned. This tragic case highlights the long-term impact of starvation on children living in the region.
amharic: በጋዛ የምትገኘው የስድስት ዓመቷ አሚራ ራሺድ አሁን ባለው ግጭት እና የምግብ እጥረት ሳቢያ ለከፍተኛ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጦት ተጋልጣለች። የልጅቷ የአካል እና የአእምሮ እድገት ላይ ዘላቂ ጉዳት በመድረሱ፣ እንደታቀደው ወደ ትምህርት ቤት መግባት አልቻለችም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በጋዛ የሚገኙ ህጻናት በረሃብ ምክንያት እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን ከባድ ቀውስ ያሳያል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti mucayyoon umuriinshee waggaa jahaa Amira Raashid jedhamtu, waraanaa fi rakkoo nyaataa irraa kan ka'e fayyaan ishee hanga kana miidhameera. Guddinnii qaamaa fi sammuushee waan miidhameef, akka karoorfatte gara mana barumsaa deemuuf hin dandeenye. Dhimmisi kun miidhaa hamaa ijoolleen Gaza keessa jiran beelaan irra gahaa jiru ifa godha.

title: Manav Suthar takes 10-wicket haul as India beat Sri Lanka in 600th Test
english: India secured a 165-run victory over Sri Lanka in their landmark 600th Test match held in Galle. Young spinner Manav Suthar was the standout performer, claiming a total of 10 wickets throughout the game to lead his team to a 1-0 series lead. Despite some resistance from the Sri Lankan middle order, the hosts were bowled out for 206 runs on the final day.
amharic: ህንድ በጋሌ በተካሄደው 600ኛው የቴስት ጨዋታዋ በስሪ ላንካ ላይ በ165 ሩጫዎች አሸንፋለች። የግራ እጅ ስፒነሩ ማናቭ ሱታር በአጠቃላይ 10 ውኬቶችን በመውሰድ ለቡድኑ ድል ቁልፍ ሚና ተጫውቷል። የስሪ ላንካ ተጫዋቾች ተቃውሞ ለማድረግ ቢሞክሩም፣ በመጨረሻው ቀን በ206 ሩጫዎች ተሸንፈው ህንድ በተከታታይ ሁለት ጨዋታዎች በሚደረገው የቴስት ውድድር 1-0 መምራት ጀምራለች።
oromo: Indiyaan tapha ishee 600ffaa kan ta'e 'Test' irratti biyya Sri Laankaa 165n injifatteetti. Isppinarri dargaggeessi Maanaav Sutaar taphicha guutuu keessatti wikeetii 10 fudhachuun injifannoo kanaaf gahee guddaa taphateera. Hoggantoonni Sri Laankaa mormii cimaa agarsiisuuf yaalanis, guyyaa dhumaa irratti 206 qofa galchuun Indiyaan sadarkaa 1-0 irra akka qaqqabdu taasiseera.

title: At least five killed in Russian air attacks on Ukraine
english: Russian airstrikes on Ukraine have resulted in the deaths of at least five civilians and left many others injured. A drone attack targeting a bus in Kherson killed four people, while another strike in Zaporizhzhia claimed one additional life and damaged local buildings. These incidents reflect an ongoing rise in civilian casualties as the long-standing conflict continues without a clear path to resolution.
amharic: በዩክሬን ላይ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ አምስት ሲቪሎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። በክሄርሰን ከተማ በአውቶብስ ላይ በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ፣ በዛፖሪዝሂያ በተፈጸመ ሌላ ጥቃት ደግሞ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህ አሰቃቂ ክስተት በጦርነቱ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የሲቪል ተጎጂዎች ቁጥር የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ግጭቱ አሁንም ምንም አይነት የመፍትሄ አቅጣጫ ሳይኖረው ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humni waraana Raashiyaa ganda Yukreen keessatti haleellaa qilleensaa gaggeesseen namoonni nagaa shan yoo du'an, kan biroon immoo hedduu madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun lakkoofsi namoota nagaa waraana kanaan miidhamanii dabaluu isaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, waraanni kun furmaata tokko malee itti fufee jira.

title: Nick Kyrgios provisionally suspended after positive test for cocaine
english: Tennis star Nick Kyrgios has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for cocaine at a tournament in Mallorca. The athlete accepted full responsibility for his actions, explaining that the mental and physical strain of recent injuries and the reality of his career nearing its end led him to a difficult place. Kyrgios has chosen not to appeal the suspension and plans to step away from the public eye for a month to focus on his personal well-being.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከብ ኒክ ኪርጊዮስ በማሎርካ በተካሄደ ውድድር ኮኬይን መውሰዱ በምርመራ በመረጋገጡ ከውድድር ታግዷል። ስፖርተኛው ለድርጊቱ ሙሉ ኃላፊነት እንደሚወስድ ገልጾ፣ በቅርብ ጊዜ ያጋጠሙት ጉዳቶች በአካልም ሆነ በአእምሮ የፈጠሩበት ጫና እና የሙያ ህይወቱ ማለቂያ ላይ መድረሱ ለዚህ ውሳኔ እንዳደረሰው ተናግሯል። ኪርጊዮስ እገዳውን ላለመቃወም የወሰነ ሲሆን፣ ለጤንነቱ እና ለግል ደህንነቱ ሲል ለአንድ ወር ያህል ከህዝብ እይታ ለመራቅ አቅዷል።
oromo: Taphatoonni tennisii Nick Kyrgios qormaata kokaayin fudhachuu isaa mallattoo argisiisuun walqabatee yeroof dorgommii irraa dhorkameera. Taphatichi dogoggora raawwateef itti gaafatamummaa guutuu fudhachuun, miidhaa qaamaa fi sammuu irra ga'aa ture akkasumas yeroon hojii isaa xumuramuuf dhihaachuun isaa dhiphina keessa akka galche ibseera. Kyrgios dhorkaa kana hin mormuuf murteessuun, fayyaa isaa irratti xiyyeeffachuuf jecha ji'a tokkoof iddoo namootni jiran irraa fagaatee turuuf karoorfateera.

title: Anti-Muslim protesters call for ‘Christian Crusade’ in Dearborn, US
english: A group of far-right protesters recently held an anti-Muslim rally in Dearborn, Michigan, which they labeled a Christian Crusade march. The demonstration took place outside a city council meeting and resulted in confrontations with local police. Authorities ultimately made several arrests as tensions escalated during the event.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ዲርቦርን ከተማ የጽንፈኛ ቡድን አባላት በሙስሊሞች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። 'የክርስቲያን የመስቀል ጦርነት ሰልፍ' በሚል ስም የተጠራው ይህ ተቃውሞ ከከተማው ምክር ቤት ስብሰባ ውጭ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። በክስተቱ ወቅትም አንዳንድ ተሳታፊዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Murni mirga-raree (far-right) magaala Diyorborn keessatti hiriira Islaamummaa mormu gaggeessaniiru. title: Cars swept downhill as flash floods hit northern Chile
english: Severe flash floods and mudslides recently devastated parts of northern Chile, forcefully pushing vehicles down hillsides. In response to the dangerous conditions, authorities declared a state of catastrophe in Tocopilla province. Emergency teams are currently working to evacuate residents and clear debris from the impacted areas.

title: UAE-backed Chinese company acquires stake in Ethiopian gold mine near Sudan warzone
english: A Canadian mining company, Allied Gold, has sold a nearly 10 percent stake of its global assets to China's Zijin Gold for $300 million. This deal includes the Kurmuk gold mine in Ethiopia’s Benishangul-Gumuz region, an area near the Sudanese border that is currently experiencing significant conflict and displacement. Because the UAE is a major shareholder in the Chinese firm and also supports the Sudanese paramilitary group operating nearby, the project has drawn attention for its complex geopolitical and humanitarian implications.
amharic: አላይድ ጎልድ የተባለ የካናዳ የማዕድን ኩባንያ በኢትዮጵያ ቤንሻንጉል ጉምዝ ክልል የሚገኘውን የወርቅ ማውጫ ጨምሮ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ባሉት ንብረቶቹ ላይ የ10 በመቶ ድርሻውን ለቻይናው ዚጂን ጎልድ በ300 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ሸጠ። የኩርሙክ ወርቅ ማውጫ የሚገኘው ከሱዳን ድንበር አቅራቢያ ግጭትና መፈናቀል በሚታይበት አካባቢ ነው። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች በቻይናው ኩባንያ ውስጥ ትልቅ ድርሻ ያላትና በሱዳን ግጭት ውስጥ ካሉ ወገኖች ጋር ግንኙነት ያላት በመሆኑ፣ ይህ ስምምነት ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Kampaniin maayiningii Kaanaadaa, 'Allied Gold' jedhamu, qooda dhibbeentaa 10 ta'u qabeenya isaa biyyoolessaa kanneen akka qotiyyoo warqee Kurmuk kan naannoo Benishangul-Gumuz Itoophiyaa keessa jiru, kampanii Chaayinaa 'Zijin Gold' jedhamutti doolaara miiliyoona 300n gurgureera. Bakki qotiyyoo Kurmuk kun daangaa Sudaanitti dhihoo fi naannoo waraanaa fi buqqaatiin itti baay'ate dha. Emireetoonni Arabaa gamtooman gahee guddaa kampanii Chaayinaa kana keessaa waan qabaniif akkasumas waraana Sudaan waliin hidhata waan qabaniif, waliigalteen kun dhimmoota geopolitics fi namuumaa irratti shakkiin akka ka'u taasiseera.

title: Israeli forces arrest 23 Palestinians in sweeping West Bank raids
english: Israeli military forces have arrested 23 Palestinians across various locations in the occupied West Bank following a series of widespread raids. During these operations, one individual was hospitalized due to injuries sustained from physical assault by soldiers. Additionally, residents in the village of Qusra are enduring an 11-day siege by settlers who have restricted their access to essential resources like food and water.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ባደረጉት ተከታታይ ወረራ 23 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በእነዚህ ኦፕሬሽኖች ወቅት አንድ ሰው በወታደሮች በተፈጸመበት ድብደባ ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ ጉዳት ተዳርጎ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስዷል። ከዚህም በላይ በቁስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎች ከምግብ እና ከውሃ አቅርቦት እንዲቋረጡ ባደረጉ ሰፋሪዎች ለ11 ቀናት በከበባ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa West Bank keessatti godinoota garaa garaatti bobba'uun Palasxinoota 23 hidhaa seeraa keessa galchaniru. Duula kana keessatti, namni tokko waraana kanaan reebamee miidhamuu isaa hordofee hospitaala galeera. Kana malees, jiraattonni baadiyaa Qusraa jedhamu, qondaaltotaafi qonnaan bultoota biyyaa lafaa isaanii irratti dhufaniin guyyoota 11f marsamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, nyaataafi bishaan akka hin arganne dhorgamanii jiru.

title: German vice chancellor urges EU to consider sanctions against Ben-Gvir
english: German Vice Chancellor Lars Klingbeil has called on the European Union to investigate potential sanctions against Israeli Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir. This reaction follows Ben-Gvir’s inflammatory remarks suggesting the nightly killing of civilians in Gaza. Klingbeil condemned the language as dehumanizing and stated that such rhetoric from a government official is completely unacceptable.
amharic: የጀርመን ምክትል ቻንስለር ላርስ ክሊንግቤይል የአውሮፓ ህብረት በእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጥል ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ የሆነው ቤን-ግቪር በጋዛ የሚገኙ ንፁሃን ዜጎች በየዕለቱ እንዲገደሉ የሚያበረታታ ንግግር በማድረጋቸው ነው። ክሊንግቤይል ይህንን አድራጎት ሰብአዊነት የጎደለው እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው ተግባር ሲሉ አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Itti aanaa chaanselarrii Jarman Laars Kilingbeeyil gamtaan Awurooppaa ministira Israa'el Itaamar Been-Gviir irratti tarkaanfii adabbii akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Kun kan ta'e Been-Gviir lammiilee Gaazaatti argaman halkan halkan akka ajjeefaman dubbachuusaanii hordofuudhaani. Kilingbeeyil jechoota kanneen namummaa kan tuqan fi guututti kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Kelsey Mitchell ties WNBA scoring record in Fever win over Tempo
english: Kelsey Mitchell made WNBA history by scoring at least 20 points for the 20th consecutive game during the Indiana Fever's 101-95 victory against the Toronto Tempo. Although Mitchell left the game early due to heat exhaustion, her performance alongside Caitlin Clark helped the Fever secure their fifth straight win. Despite a late rally by Toronto, Indiana maintained their lead to hand the Tempo their 11th consecutive loss.
amharic: ኬልሲ ሚቸል ኢንዲያና ፋቨር ከቶሮንቶ ቴምፖ ጋር ባደረጉት ጨዋታ 20 ነጥቦችን በማስመዝገብ በWNBA ታሪክ ለ20 ተከታታይ ጨዋታዎች ይህንን ውጤት ያስመዘገበች የመጀመሪያዋ ተጫዋች ሆናለች። ሚቸል በጨዋታው ወቅት በሙቀት ምክንያት ቢወጡም፣ ከኬትሊን ክላርክ ጋር በመሆን ቡድናቸው 101 ለ 95 እንዲያሸንፍ አስችለዋል። ይህ የኢንዲያና አምስተኛ ተከታታይ ድል ሲሆን ቶሮንቶ ደግሞ 11ኛ ተከታታይ ሽንፈቱን አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Keelsii Miicheel tapha Indiyaanaa Feevarii fi Toroontoo Teempoo gidduutti gaggeeffame irratti qabxii 20 ol galchuudhaan seenaa WNBA keessatti taphattuu yeroo 20 walitti aansuun qabxii kana galchite taateetti. Miicheel ho'a qilleensaa irraa kan ka'e taphicha gidduutti kan baate ta'us, Keetiliin Klaarkii wajjin ta'uun gareen isaanii 101-95 akka mo'atu gargaarteetti. Injifannoon kun Feevariif injifannoo shanaffaa yeroo ta'u, gareen Teempoo garuu yeroo 11ffaaf mo'atamaniiru.

title: Ukraine’s sacked defence minister calls for wartime elections
english: Ukraine's former defense minister has requested that the country hold elections despite the ongoing war with Russia. He argues that the nation is currently dealing with a serious leadership and governance crisis. This request marks the first time a prominent Ukrainian political leader has pushed for such a vote since the conflict started in 2022.
amharic: የዩክሬን የቀድሞ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ከሩሲያ ጋር እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ቢኖርም ሀገሪቱ ምርጫ እንድታካሂድ ጠይቀዋል። አሁን ያለው የአመራር ክፍተት ሀገሪቱን በከፍተኛ ቀውስ ውስጥ እንደከተታትም ተናግረዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ ከ2022 ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ አንድ ታዋቂ የፖለቲካ ሰው ምርጫ እንዲደረግ በይፋ ሲጠይቅ የመጀመሪያው ነው።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa kan duraanii kan Yukreen, waraanni Raashiyaa wajjin adeemsifamaa jiru akkuma jirutti ta'ee, biyyattiin filannoo akka gaggeessitu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan ammaa rakkoo bulchiinsaafi gaggeessummaa keessa jiraachuu isaa ibsaniiru. Kunis, waraanni bara 2022 erga eegalee booda hogganaan siyaasaa biyyattii beekamaan tokko filannoo akka gaggeeffamu yeroo gaafatan kan jalqabaati.

title: Breastfeeding in Gaza: Mothers seek help to provide for their babies
english: Mothers in Gaza are facing extreme challenges in breastfeeding their infants due to widespread hunger, displacement, and the severe lack of medical supplies caused by the ongoing war. Many women struggle with physical health complications and malnutrition, making it difficult to sustain breastfeeding without professional support. Health centers are stepping in to provide guidance and assistance to hundreds of mothers each month who are navigating these harsh living conditions.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ እናቶች በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በተፈጠረው ረሃብ፣ መፈናቀል እና የህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት የተነሳ ልጆቻቸውን ለማጥባት ከፍተኛ ችግር እየገጠማቸው ነው። ብዙ እናቶች በጤና መታወክ እና በምግብ እጥረት ምክንያት ጡት ለማጥባት ሲቸገሩ ይታያል። በችግር ውስጥ ያሉ እናቶችን ለመርዳት የጤና ጣቢያዎች በየወሩ በመቶዎች ለሚቆጠሩ እናቶች አስፈላጊውን ምክር እና ድጋፍ እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gaazaatti haadhonni waraana jiruun walqabatee beela, buqqaatii fi hanqina qorichaatiin walqabatee ijoollee isaanii harma hoosisuuf rakkataa jiru. Haadhonni hedduun rakkoo fayyaa fi hanqina soorataan kanneen harma hoosisuun itti ulfaateedha. Buufatonni fayyaa rakkoo kana keessa kan jiran haadholii dhibbaan lakkaawaman gorsa fi deeggarsa barbaachisaa ta'e kennuun gargaaraa jiru.

title: Sabalenka cruises through as Medvedev falls to Nakashima at Cincinnati Open
english: Aryna Sabalenka reached the fourth round of the Cincinnati Masters after a quick victory over Wang Xinyu. Meanwhile, Daniil Medvedev was unexpectedly eliminated from the tournament by Brandon Nakashima. Other top players like Coco Gauff and Mirra Andreeva also secured wins to advance in their respective brackets.
amharic: አሪና ሳባሌንካ በሲንሲናቲ ማስተርስ ውድድር ዋንግ ዢንዩን በፍጥነት በማሸነፍ ወደ አራተኛው ዙር አልፋለች። በሌላ በኩል ዳኒል ሜድቬዴቭ በብራንዶን ናካሺማ ያልተጠበቀ ሽንፈት ገጥሞት ከውድድሩ ውጪ ሆኗል። እንደ ኮኮ ጋፍ እና ሚራ አንድሬቫ ያሉ ሌሎች ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያላቸው ተጫዋቾችም ቀጣዩን ዙር መቀላቀል ችለዋል።
oromo: Aryna Sabalenka morkii Cincinnati Masters irratti Wang Xinyu ariitiin injifachuun gara naannoo afuraffaatti dabarteetti. Gama biraan, Daniil Medvedev morkataa isaa Brandon Nakashima dura injifatamuu isaatiin rikoordiidhaan mo'amee dorgommicha irraa ba'eera. Taphattootni beekamoon biroo akka Coco Gauff fi Mirra Andreeva injifannoo argachuun gara fuulduraatti darbaniiru.

title: Musiala collapses for Bayern again as ‘neurological disorder’ diagnosed
english: Bayern Munich midfielder Jamal Musiala has experienced two fainting spells during preseason matches, leading to a diagnosis of treatable absence seizures caused by a neurological condition. Despite these incidents, the 23-year-old is feeling positive and is working closely with medical experts to manage his health. He intends to continue his daily life and professional football career while receiving proper care, with no further long-term health risks expected.
amharic: የባየር ሙኒኩ አማካኝ ጀማል ሙሲያላ በቅድመ ውድድር ጨዋታዎች ላይ በሁለት አጋጣሚዎች በድንገት በመውደቁ ምክንያት የነርቭ ችግር እንዳለበት ታውቋል። ተጫዋቹ ምርመራ ከተደረገለት በኋላ የሚያጋጥመው ችግር በቀላሉ ሊታከም የሚችል አይነት መሆኑን ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን ክስተቱ ቢከሰትም፣ የ23 ዓመቱ ኮከብ በጥሩ ስሜት ላይ እንደሚገኝ እና በህክምና ባለሙያዎች ክትትል እየተደረገለት እግር ኳሱን እንደሚቀጥል አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Taphatni giddu-galeessa Bayern Munich Jamaal Musiyaalaa, taphoota qophii irratti al lama lafatti kufee erga argamee booda, dhibee narvii fayyuu danda'u tokko akka qabu mirkanaa'eera. Umuriin isaa waggaa 23 kan ta'e kun, dhibee kana to'achuuf ogeeyyii fayyaa waliin hojjechaa akka jiru ibseera. Jamaal haalli fayyaa isaa kan isa abdachiisu ta'uu fi miidhaan yeroo dheeraa akka hin jirree fi ogummaa isaa tapha kubbaa miilaa itti fufuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaa beeksisera.

title: Iran records $7.5bn in oil earnings during first four months of 2026
english: Iran generated $7.5 billion from oil exports during the first four months of 2026, representing a significant 50 percent rise compared to the previous year. These funds were deposited into the nation's central bank to help meet government foreign currency needs through December. This financial performance occurred despite the ongoing military conflict with Israel and the United States that began in late February.
amharic: ኢራን በ2026 የመጀመሪያዎቹ አራት ወራት ውስጥ ከነዳጅ ሽያጭ 7.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ማግኘቷን አስታውቃለች፤ ይህም ከባለፈው ዓመት ተመሳሳይ ወቅት ጋር ሲነጻጸር የ50 በመቶ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። መንግሥት ይህንን ገቢ እስከ ታህሳስ ወር መጨረሻ ድረስ ያለውን የውጭ ምንዛሪ ፍላጎት ለማሟላት እንደሚጠቀምበት ተገልጿል። ይህ ውጤት የተገኘው ከየካቲት ወር መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከእስራኤል እና ከአሜሪካ ጋር በተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት ውስጥ መሆኑም ተመላክቷል።
oromo: Iiraan waggaa 2026 ji'oota arfan jalqabaatti gurgurtaa boba'aarraa doolaara biiliyoona 7.5 argachuushee beeksisteerti; kunis waggaa darbe waliin yoo madaalamu daballii dhibbeentaa 50 ta'a. Mootummaan galii kana hanga dhuma ji'a Muddee tti fedhii maallaqa alaa biyyattii guutuuf akka itti fayyadamu eegama. Galii kana kan argatte waraana Isiraa'elii fi Ameerikaa waliin qabdu keessatti ta'us gabaasameera.

title: Mushroom murderer trial undermined by 'catastrophic' hotel mix-up, court told
english: Erin Patterson, who is serving a life sentence for poisoning three relatives with deadly mushrooms, is seeking to overturn her conviction. Her legal team argues that the trial was compromised because jurors were accidentally booked into the same hotel as the prosecution team and a key witness. Meanwhile, prosecutors are separately appealing her sentence, claiming that the required time before she can seek parole is too short.
amharic: በገዳይ እንጉዳይ ሶስት ዘመዶቿን በመግደሏ የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት የተፈረደባት ኤሪን ፓተርሰን፣ ፍርዱ እንዲሻርላት ይግባኝ ጠይቃለች። የህግ ባለሙያዎቿ ዳኞች ከዐቃቤ ህግ ቡድን እና ከዋና ምስክር ጋር በአንድ ሆቴል እንዲቆዩ መደረጉ በህግ ሂደቱ ላይ መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል በማለት ይከራከራሉ። በሌላ በኩል ዐቃቤ ህግ የተፈረደባት የይቅርታ ጊዜ በጣም አጭር ነው በማለት ቅጣቱ እንዲጨመር ይግባኝ ማቅረባቸውን ሰምተናል።
oromo: Erin Paatarsan, namoota sadii yeroo du’aatti qaqqabsiisuun mana hidhaa waggaa guutuu jirtu, murtii irratti darbe kana mormattee jirti. Abukaatonni ishee, qaamni murteessu (jury) garee himataa fi ragaa guddaa waliin hoteela tokko keessa turuun isaanii adeemsa seeraa kan miidhe ta’uu dubbatu. Gamasaatiin, qaamni himataa murtii isheerratti darbe akkasumas yeroon gaaffii hiikkaa itti gaafachuu dandeessu gabaabaa ta’uu isaa ibsuun, adabbii ishee cimsuuf iyyata dhiyeeffatanii jiru.

title: 'Violence, dispossession, and destruction': Israeli forces and settlers launch 467 West Bank attacks in one week
english: The Palestinian prime minister's office reported that Israeli forces and settlers carried out 467 attacks in the occupied West Bank within a single week. These incidents led to the destruction of at least 75 Palestinian homes and various other properties. Officials have characterized this surge in activity as a continuous campaign of displacement and aggression against local communities.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽህፈት ቤት ባወጣው መግለጫ፣ በባለፈው አንድ ሳምንት ብቻ እስራኤላውያን ኃይሎች እና ሰፈራተኞች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ 467 ጥቃቶችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ 75 የፍልስጤም ቤቶችንና ሌሎች ንብረቶችን አውድመዋል። የመንግስት አካላት ይህንን ድርጊት በዜጎች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለ ቀጣይነት ያለው የኃይል እርምጃ እና የማፈናቀል ዘመቻ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Waajjirri muummee ministiraa Filisxiim akka ibsetti, torban darbe keessa qofa waraanni Israa'el fi qubattoonni zoonii dhiha (West Bank) keessatti haleellaa 467 raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan manneen jireenyaa fi qabeenyawwan Filisxiimotaa 75 ol ta'an manca'aniiru. Mootummaan haleellaa kana sochii itti fufiinsa qabu kan namoota qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqisuu fi miidhaa geessisuu akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Mecca agreement: Why Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan teamed up at this historical moment
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, marking a shift toward regional self-reliance rather than depending on a single foreign power. By combining Saudi Arabia's economic and energy influence, Turkey's military and geographical importance, and Pakistan's nuclear and strategic capabilities, the nations aim to create a collective defense network. This pact establishes that an attack on one is an attack on all, focusing on long-term security cooperation in a changing geopolitical landscape.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት፣ ከአንድ የውጭ ኃይል ጥገኝነት በመውጣት በራስ የመተማመን ስልት ላይ ያተኮረ ነው። ይህ ስምምነት የሳውዲን ኢኮኖሚ እና የኢነርጂ አቅም፣ የቱርክን ወታደራዊ እና መልክዓ ምድራዊ ጠቀሜታ፣ እንዲሁም የፓኪስታንን የኒውክሌር እና ስልታዊ ጥንካሬ በማጣመር የጋራ መከላከያ ኔትወርክ ለመመስረት ያለመ ነው። አንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሶስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ የሚቆጥር ይህ ስምምነት፣ ተለዋዋጭ በሆነው የዓለም ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ዘላቂ ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiifi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisa biyyaa kan Makkaatti mallatteessan, dhiibbaa biyyoota alaa irraa bilisa ta'uufi of danda'uuf kan gargaaruudha. Waligalteen kun qabeenya dinagdeefi anniisaa Saudii, dandeettii waraanaafi bakka jireenyaa Turki, akkasumas humna niwukilaraafi tarsiimoo Paakistaan walitti fiduun ittisa gamtaa uumuuf kan karoorfamedha. Biyyoota sadan kana keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, kanneen biroos akka haleelametti kan lakkaa'amu ta'uun, waligalteen kun nageenya naannichaa mirkaneessuuf tarkaanfii murteessaadha.

title: French civil servant drugged us to make us urinate on ourselves, say accusers
english: Nearly 250 women have come forward accusing a former French government official, Christian Nègre, of drugging them during job interviews between 2009 and 2018. Victims claim he spiked their drinks to induce a loss of physical control, causing them to urinate on themselves while he watched with disturbing satisfaction. These allegations highlight a pattern of chemical submission, a serious issue that has gained significant national attention in France.
amharic: ከ250 የሚበልጡ ሴቶች የፈረንሳይ የመንግስት ሰራተኛ የነበረው ክርስቲያን ኔግሬ በስራ ቃለ መጠይቅ ወቅት አደንዛዥ እፅ በመስጠት እንደጎዳቸው ከሰዋል። ተጎጂዎቹ እንደተናገሩት ሰውየው መጠጣቸው ላይ መድኃኒት በመጨመር ሰውነታቸውን መቆጣጠር እንዳይችሉ በማድረግ በራሳቸው ላይ ሽንታቸውን እንዲሸኑ ያደርጋቸው ነበር። ይህ ክስተት በፈረንሳይ ትልቅ ትኩረት ያገኘውን በኃይል አደንዛዥ እፅ ሰለባ የማድረግ ወንጀልን በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Dubartoonni gara 250 ta'an qondaalli mootummaa Faransaay durii, Christian Nègre, giddu galeessa bara 2009 hanga 2018tti yeroo hojii gaafatamanii qorannoo irratti qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu itti fayyadame jedhanii himatu. Namichi kun dhugaatii isaanii keessatti qoricha naannessuun qaama isaanii to'achuu akka dadhabanii fi yeroo isaan of wallaalanii fincaan irratti fixatan ofiin ilaaluun gammaduu himatameera. Himannoon kun Faransaay keessatti rakkoo cimaa ta'e kan qorichaan nama hiraarsuu ifatti baaseera.

title: South Korea says Trump’s drill cuts seem to be pushing Seoul into war on Iran
english: South Korea's foreign minister stated that President Trump’s sudden decision to reduce joint military exercises may be a strategy to pressure Seoul into participating in the conflict with Iran. This directive was issued unexpectedly, catching officials from both nations off guard. The minister suggested that this move serves multiple purposes, including sending a message to North Korea and attempting to resolve the ongoing deadlock in the Iran war.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር እንደገለጹት፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን ለመቀነስ የወሰዱት ያልታሰበ እርምጃ ደቡብ ኮሪያን በኢራን ጦርነት ውስጥ ለማሳተፍ የሚደረግ ግፊት ሊሆን ይችላል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከሁለቱም ሀገራት ባለስልጣናት ጋር ሳይመካከር በድንገት የተወሰደ ነው። ሚኒስትሩ ይህ አካሄድ ለሰሜን ኮሪያ መልእክት ለማስተላለፍ እና በኢራን ጦርነት ያለውን አጣብቂኝ ለመፍታት የታቀደ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa akka jedhutti, murtoon pirezidaant Traamp shaakala waraanaa gamtaa hir'isuuf tasa fudhatan, Kooriyaa Kibbaa waraana Iraan keessatti hirmaachisuuf dhiibbaa gochuu ta'uu mala. Murtoon kun kan fudhatame qondaaltota biyyoota lamaanii osoo hin mariisisin tasa ta'e. Ministirichi tarkaanfiin kun qondaaltota biyyoota lamaanii biratti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, Kaaba Kooriyaaf ergaa dabarsuu fi waraana Iraan keessatti haala jiru furuuf kan kaayyeffate ta'uu ibse.

title: Iran warns countries against 'assistance or facilitation' of US army
english: A senior Iranian military official has warned neighboring nations against letting the United States use their land for military operations against Iran. Tehran emphasized that it is closely monitoring these countries and will consider any logistical support provided to U.S. forces as a direct act of aggression. Consequently, Iran considers any such assistance equivalent to taking part in a military attack against them.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የኢራን ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን ጎረቤት ሀገራት አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር መሬታቸውን እንዳትጠቀም አስጠንቅቀዋል። ቴህራን እንደገለጸችው በሀገራቱ ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በቅርበት እየተከታተለች እንደሆነ እና ለአሜሪካ ጦር የሚሰጥ ማንኛውም ድጋፍ እንደ ጠላትነት እንደሚቆጠር አስታውቃለች። በመሆኑም ኢራን እንደዚህ አይነት ትብብር ያደረጉ ሀገራትን በአሜሪካ የጦር እንቅስቃሴ ውስጥ እንደ ተሳታፊ እንደምትመለከት አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan biyyoonni ollaa ta'an tokko tokko waraana Ameerikaa irratti akka hin gargaarre akeekkachiisaniiru. Iraan tarkaanfii kamiyyuu kan waraana Ameerikaa deggeru akka itti-gaafatamaatti kan fudhatamu ta'uu ibsiteerti. Kanaafuu, biyyoonni naannichaa lafa isaanii waraana Ameerikaaf yoo kennan, Iraan akka isaan waraana sana keessatti hirmaatanitti ilaaltee tarkaanfii akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Israel’s starvation of Gaza leaves children stunted
english: Six-year-old Amira Rashid is suffering from severe, permanent health issues due to extreme malnutrition caused by Israel's ongoing blockade of Gaza. Despite medical intervention, the long-term lack of food has left her physically stunted, with her development now comparable to that of a toddler. Her mother expressed deep despair, noting that her daughter is too weak to attend school or interact with other children because of the lasting damage to her body.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው የእስራኤል እገዳ ምክንያት በደረሰው ከባድ የምግብ እጥረት የ6 ዓመቷ አሚራ ራሺድ በቋሚነት ለጤና መታወክ ተዳርጋለች። ለረጅም ጊዜ በቂ ምግብ ባለማግኘቷ የአካል እድገቷ የተገታ ሲሆን፣ አሁን ያለችበት የጤና ሁኔታ ከሁለት ዓመት ህፃን ጋር የሚቀራረብ ሆኗል። እናቷ እንደገለጹት፣ ልጃቸው የደረሰባት የጤና መቃወስ ከባድ በመሆኑ ትምህርት ቤት ለመግባትም ሆነ ከሌሎች ልጆች ጋር ለመጫወት የሚያስችል አቅም እንደሌላት እና ተስፋ እንደቆረጡ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Amira Raashiid kan umriin ishee waggaa ja'a ta'e, sababa uggura Israa'el gaazaa irratti gooteen rakkoo nyaata dhabuutiin miidhamteetti. title: Morning update
english: Tensions in the region remain high as Turkey rejected Israeli claims regarding its military involvement in Syria, accusing the Israeli leadership of political posturing. Meanwhile, infrastructure has been damaged by a pipeline explosion in Syria, and reports indicate further Israeli military raids and airstrikes. Additionally, Hamas has criticized recent Israeli actions in Gaza, labeling them as a significant escalation of violence.

title: Israeli shelling, air strikes reported across south Lebanon
english: The Israeli military conducted a series of attacks across southern Lebanon, including airstrikes in the Nabatieh district and artillery fire in several towns. Soldiers also carried out building demolitions and deployed surveillance drones alongside illumination flares over residential areas. These widespread strikes have heightened tensions across multiple locations in the region.

Gochi kun naannichatti waldhabdee fi sodaa dabalee jira.

title: Scaling back US-South Korea drills may fail to woo Kim away from China
english: President Trump is reducing military drills between the US and South Korea to encourage new diplomatic discussions with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. However, analysts believe this strategy might be ineffective because Kim continues to maintain strong ties with China and Russia. Consequently, North Korea shows little interest in returning to negotiations at this time.

title: Ukraine’s ousted defence minister calls for elections during war
english: Former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has become the first high-ranking official to call for elections to be held despite the ongoing war with Russia. He argued that Ukraine must maintain its democratic processes even during conflict and suggested that systemic governance issues and corruption are harming the nation's efforts. While Ukrainian law currently prohibits elections under martial law, this move marks a significant political challenge to President Zelenskyy's leadership.
amharic: የዩክሬን የቀድሞ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ሚካሂሎ ፌዶሮቭ፣ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ያለው ጦርነት ቢኖርም ምርጫዎች እንዲካሄዱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ፌዶሮቭ ዩክሬን በጦርነት ወቅትም ቢሆን ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሥርዓቷን ማስቀጠል እንዳለባት በመግለጽ፣ በአገሪቱ እየታዩ ያሉ የመልካም አስተዳደር ችግሮች እና ሙስና የጦርነቱን ጥረት እየጎዱ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። አሁን ያለው የዩክሬን ሕግ በጦርነት ወቅት ምርጫ ማድረግን የሚከለክል ቢሆንም፣ የፌዶሮቭ ጥያቄ በፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ አስተዳደር ላይ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ተግዳሮትን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa kan duraanii Yukreen, Mihaayiloo Fedorov, waraanni Raashiyaa wajjin geggeeffamaa jiru akkuma itti fufetti filannoon akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Fedorov akka jedhanitti, Yukreen haala waraana keessa taatus adeemsa dimokiraasii ishee eeguu qabdi; akkasumas, rakkooleen bulchiinsaa fi malaammaltummaan yaalii waraana biyyattii miidhaa akka jiran dubbataniiru. Seerri Yukreen yeroo waraanaa filannoo gaggeessuu kan dhowwu ta'us, yaanni Fedorov kun hoogganummaa Pirezidaant Zelenskiin dorgommii siyaasaa guddaa keessa galcheera.

title: Lebanon no longer a safe haven for former Syrian regime officials
english: Following the collapse of the Bashar al-Assad regime, many former Syrian officials who sought refuge in Lebanon now face the risk of extradition. The new Syrian government is actively pursuing these individuals to hold them accountable for alleged war crimes committed during the long-standing conflict. Lebanese authorities have already begun detaining high-ranking figures, such as a former major general, signaling that Lebanon is no longer a guaranteed safe haven for those associated with the previous administration.
amharic: የበሽር አል-አሳድ መንግስት ከወደቀ በኋላ በሊባኖስ ተጠልለው የነበሩ በርካታ የቀድሞ የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ወደ አገራቸው የመመለስ ወይም ለፍርድ የመቅረብ ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል። አዲሱ የሶሪያ መንግስት በጦርነቱ ወቅት ለፈጸሙት ወንጀል ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ እነዚህን ግለሰቦች በህግ ለመያዝ እየሰራ ነው። የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የተደበቁ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አመራሮችን በቁጥጥር ስር ማዋል በመጀመራቸው፣ ሊባኖስ ለቀድሞው የሶሪያ መንግስት ባለስልጣናት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መጠለያ መሆኗ አብቅቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Bashar al-Asaad erga kufee booda, qondaaltotni mootummaa darbee kanneen gara Libanon baqatan hedduun gara biyyaatti deebifamuuf saaxilamaniiru. Mootummaan Siiriyaa haaraan namoota kana waraana keessatti yakka raawwataniif itti gaafatamtoota taasisuuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jira. Abbootiin taayitaa Libanon qondaaltota waraanaa ol aanoo qabuu waan eegalaniif, biyyattiin namoota mootummaa duraanii sanaaf iddoo baqannaa amansiisaa ta'uun ishee xumurameera.

title: Report: Israel halting all defence exports to Qatar
english: Israel has decided to stop all future defense exports to Qatar, labeling the country as hostile to its interests. This new policy ends all past support and maintenance agreements related to previous military sales. The move marks a complete reversal of the nation's earlier approval of defense exports to Doha.

title: Iran's top negotiator says ties with Iraq 'cannot be severed'
english: Iran's parliament speaker, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, recently met with Iraqi officials to emphasize the strong and unbreakable historical ties between their two nations. During these discussions in Baghdad, the leaders focused on increasing strategic cooperation and working together to improve regional security. Ghalibaf stated that their shared history and mutual values will continue to guide their future relationship.

Galiibaf akka ibsetti, seenaan waliinii fi walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota kanaa gara fuulduraattis kan itti fufu fi kan cimuu ta'a.

title: Watch: Qatar says Hormuz Strait deal crucial for US-Iran talks
english: A Qatari official stated that reaching a deal to secure the Strait of Hormuz is a vital step toward restarting diplomatic negotiations between the United States and Iran. Qatar believes that resolving this maritime passage issue would significantly improve the atmosphere for broader talks. The announcement highlights Qatar's ongoing role in trying to facilitate diplomatic progress in the region.
amharic: የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ የሚደረግ ስምምነት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል የሚደረገውን ድርድር ለመቀጠል ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖረዋል። ኳታር ይህንን የባህር መንገድ ችግር መፍታት ለቀጣይ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች ትልቅ መነቃቃትን እንደሚፈጥር ታምናለች። ይህ መግለጫ ኳታር በቀጠናው ውስጥ ለሚደረጉ የሰላም ጥረቶች እያደረገች ያለውን አስተዋጽኦ ያሳያል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Qaxar akka ibsetti, walii galtee daandii galaana Hormuz nagaa taasisuun marii biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti jalqabuuf gargaarsa guddaa qaba. Qaxar rakkoo daandii galaana kanaa furuun marii bal'aa gaggeessuuf haala mijataa akka uumu amanti. Ibsi kun, Qaxar naannichatti adeemsa diippilomaasii cimsuuf gahee taphachaa jirtu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Hamas accuses Israel of undermining Gaza ceasefire deal after deadly attack on Gaza City
english: Hamas has blamed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for sabotaging ongoing Gaza ceasefire negotiations following a deadly Israeli airstrike in Gaza City. The group characterized the attack, which resulted in the deaths of seven people, as an intentional effort to derail international peace initiatives. Despite these developments, Hamas insists that Palestinian factions remain committed to the mediation process.
amharic: ሀማስ በጋዛ ከተማ የደረሰውን ገዳይ የአየር ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሰላም ንግግሮችን ሆን ብለው እያደናቀፉ ነው ሲል ከሷል። ሰባት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገው ይህ ጥቃት፣ የአለም አቀፍ የሰላም ጥረቶችን ለማጨናገፍ የታቀደ ነው ሲል ቡድኑ አስታውቋል። ሆኖም ሀማስ፣ የፍልስጤም ቡድኖች ለድርድር ሂደቱ ያላቸው ቁርጠኝነት እንደቀጠለ ገልጿል።
oromo: Hamas haleellaa cimaa magaala Gazaatti raawwatamee fi lubbuu namoota torba galaafate booda, muummichi ministeera Israa'el Biniyaamin Netaaniyaahuu marii nagaa gufachiisaa jiraachuu isaanii himateera. Gareen kun haleellaan kun carraaqqii nagaa idil-addunyaa gufachiisuuf kan yaadame akka ta'e ibseera. Ta'us, gareen Hamas fi gareewwan biroo kan Falisxiin marii nagaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo isaanii akka itti fufan mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Former US official calls shift in relations with Syria ‘surreal’
english: A former US State Department advisor described the evolving relationship between Washington and Damascus as surprising but logical. The official noted that the current Syrian leadership's goals now align with American interests regarding regional stability. Both nations are increasingly focused on managing security concerns and containing extremist groups.
amharic: የቀድሞ የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መስሪያ ቤት አማካሪ በዋሽንግተን እና በደማስቆ መካከል የተፈጠረውን ግንኙነት እንግዳ ቢሆንም ምክንያታዊ ነው ብለውታል። አሁን ያለው የሶሪያ አመራር ግቦች ከክልላዊ መረጋጋት አንጻር ከአሜሪካ ፍላጎቶች ጋር የሚጣጣሙ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ለመቆጣጠር እና ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን ለመግታት በትኩረት እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Gorsaan duraanii Ministeera Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa tokko hariiroon Washington fi Damascus gidduutti uumame nama dhibus waan bu’uura qabu ta’uu ibsaniiru. Hooggansi haaraan Sooriyaa yeroo ammaa fedhii Ameerikaa kan ta’e tasgabbii naannichaa mirkaneessuuf walii galuun isaanii kan ibsameedha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu amma xiyyeeffannoo isaanii nageenya eeguu fi garee hidhattootaa to’achuu irratti gochaa jiru.

title: South Korea, US scale back annual military drills after Trump’s order
english: Following an order from President Donald Trump, the United States and South Korea have significantly shortened their annual Ulchi Freedom Shield military exercises. The drills were reduced from 11 days to five, with many field maneuvers being canceled or replaced by computer simulations. Officials indicated that this move, which caught both nations by surprise, is linked to President Trump’s diplomacy with North Korea and his desire to pressure South Korea to participate in the ongoing conflict against Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሰጡት ትዕዛዝ መሠረት አሜሪካ እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ የሚያደርጉትን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ ጊዜ ቀንሰዋል። የኡልቺ ፍሪደም ሽልድ የተሰኘው ልምምድ ከ11 ቀናት ወደ አምስት ቀናት ዝቅ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ ብዙ የመስክ እንቅስቃሴዎች ተሰርዘው በኮምፒውተር መመሰል ምትክ እንዲደረጉ ተደርጓል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሁለቱንም አገራት ያስገረመ ሲሆን፣ ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ካለው ዲፕሎማሲ እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ በኢራን ላይ በሚካሄደው ጦርነት እንድትሳተፍ ከሚደረግ ግፊት ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp ajaja kennaniin wal qabatee, Ameerikaan fi Koriyaan Kibbaa leenjii waraanaa waggaa isaanii gabaabsuu murteessaniiru. Leenjiin 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' jedhamu guyyoota 11 irraa gara guyyoota shanitti kan gadi bu'e yoo ta'u, sochiiwwan lafa irratti ta'an baay'een isaanii haquun leenjii kompiitaratti jijjiirameera. Murtoon kun biyyoota lamaanuu kan rifachiise yoo ta'u, hariiroo Traamp Koriyaa Kaabaa waliin qabaniifi dhiibbaa Koriyaan Kibbaa waraana Iraan irratti akka hirmaattu barbaadamu waliin kan wal qabate dha.

title: Attackers go ‘house to house’ killing 25 villagers in central Nigeria
english: At least 25 people were killed in a brutal raid on a village located in Nigeria's Plateau state. Witnesses reported that armed attackers moved between homes targeting residents, with women and children making up the majority of those who died. Local authorities are investigating the tragedy following this targeted act of violence.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ፕላቶ ግዛት በሚገኝ አንድ መንደር በተፈጸመ አሰቃቂ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 25 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የአይን እማኞች እንደገለጹት አጥቂዎቹ ከቤት ወደ ቤት በመሄድ ነዋሪዎችን ያጠቁ ሲሆን፣ ከተገደሉት መካከል አብዛኛዎቹ ሴቶችና ህጻናት ናቸው። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የታቀደ ጥቃት እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Pilaatoo kan Naayijeeriyaa keessatti, baadiyyaa tokko irratti haleellaa suukanneessaa mudateen namoonni 25 ol ta’an ajjeefamaniiru. Oddeeffannoon akka ibsutti, hidhattoonni manaa manatti deemuun namoota irratti haleellaa kan raawwatan yoo ta’u, miidhamtoonni hedduun isaanii dubartootaa fi daa’immanii dha. Qaamoleen nageenyaa haleellaa kana hordofee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
english: South Korea has decided to shorten its annual joint military exercises with the United States at Washington's request. President Trump pushed for the reduction to cut costs and ease tensions with North Korea, while also expressing frustration that South Korea declined to support US operations in Iran. Details regarding the specific scale of the remaining drills are still being finalized.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ መንግስት ከአሜሪካ ጋር የሚያደርገውን አመታዊ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ በአሜሪካ ጥያቄ መሰረት ለማሳጠር ወስኗል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ወጪን ለመቀነስ እና ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ ደቡብ ኮሪያ በኢራን ጉዳይ ላይ ድጋፍ ባለመስጠቷ ያላቸውን ቅር መሰኘትም ገልጸዋል። የቀሩት ልምምዶች ምን ያህል እንደሚቀነሱ ዝርዝር ጉዳዮች አሁንም በውይይት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Koreen Kibbaa leenjii waraana waggaa waggaan Ameerikaa waliin taasiftu gaaffii Waashingitan hordoftee guyyoota muraasaan gabaabsuuf murteessiteetti. Pirezidaant Traamp baasii hir'isuufi hariiroo Koriyaa Kaabaa waliin jiru tasgabbeessuuf yaadanii murtee kana kan dabarsan yoo ta'u, gama biraanis Koriyaan Kibbaa dhimma Iraan irratti gargaarsa waan diddeef aaruu isaanii ibsaniiru. Leenjichi hammam akka hir'atu ilaalchisee ibsi bal'aan gara fuulduraatti kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Husband and mother-in-law charged over Indian bride's death
english: Indian authorities have charged the husband and mother-in-law of model Twisha Sharma with abetment to suicide and cruelty following her death five months after marriage. The Central Bureau of Investigation concluded that persistent mental harassment drove her to end her own life, though her family initially alleged she was murdered over dowry disputes. Both accused, who have backgrounds in the legal profession, maintain their innocence and deny the charges.
amharic: የህንድ የፌደራል ፖሊስ ሞዴል ትዊሻ ሻርማ ከተጋቡ አምስት ወራት በኋላ መሞቷን ተከትሎ ባሏን እና አማቷን ራስን ማጥፋት እንዲያደርጉ በማነሳሳት እና ጭካኔ በተሞላበት ድርጊት ከሰሳቸው። ምርመራውን የሚያካሂደው የህንድ ማዕከላዊ ምርመራ ቢሮ፣ ተጎጂዋ ለከፍተኛ የሥነ ልቦና ትንኮሳ በመዳረጓ ህይወቷን እንዳጠፋች ገልጿል። ቤተሰቦቿ ለድህረ-ጋብቻ ስጦታ (dowry) ሲባል ግድያ እንደተፈጸመባት ቢከሱም፣ የሕግ ባለሙያ የሆኑት ተከሳሾቹ ግን ወንጀሉን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin Indiyaa moodeela Twisha Sharma jedhamtu gaa'ela ishee erga raawwatte ji'a shan booda du'uun ishee kanneen sababa ta'an jechuun abbaa manaa ishee fi harmeewwan ishee irratti himata bane. Qorannoon biyyoolessaa Indiyaa akka ibsetti, dubartiin kun rakkina sammuu irra gahuu isheetiin of ajjeesuun ishee kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, maatiin ishee garuu qabeenya (dowry) irraa kan ka'e ajjeefamuu ishee himatanii turan. Abbaan manaa ishee fi harmeewwan ishee gocha kana akka hin raawwanne himachuun yakka irratti dhiyaate haalaniiru.

title: Bali gym owner kicks out three Israeli tourists for links to ‘IDF’
english: A gym owner located in Ubud, Bali, recently made headlines after recording a video of himself ejecting three Israeli tourists from his fitness facility. The proprietor stated that his decision to ban them was motivated by their alleged connections to the Israeli military. This incident was documented and shared by the owner across his social media platforms.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ባሊ የሚገኝ የአንድ ጂም ባለቤት ሶስት የእስራኤል ቱሪስቶችን ከአገልግሎት ውጪ በማድረግ ከስፖርት ማዘውተሪያው እንዳባረራቸው የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ለቋል። ባለቤቱ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው ግለሰቦቹ ከእስራኤል መከላከያ ሠራዊት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል ምክንያት እንደሆነ አስረድቷል። የዚህ ክስተት ምስል በተለያዩ የማህበራዊ ትስስር ገፆች ላይ ተሰራጭቷል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa boqonnaa qaamaa (gym) biyya Indoneezhiyaa magaalaa Baali keessatti argamu tokko, turisoota Israa'eel sadii ta'an bakka isaatii ari'uu isaa viidiyoon ragaa ba'eera. Abbaan qabeenyichaa akka jedhetti, tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate turisootni kunneen waraana Israa'eel (IDF) waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu jechuun dha. Gochi kun viidiyoo gara miidiyaalee hawaasaatti gadhiifameen ifa ta'eera.

title: US unions sue over new visa rule for foreign students, journalists
english: A group of labor unions and advocacy organizations has filed a lawsuit to stop a new US government policy that restricts visa durations for international students, exchange visitors, and journalists. Under the new regulations, student and exchange visas are capped at four years, while media visas are severely shortened to 240 days. The plaintiffs argue that these changes will harm academic institutions and deter international talent, though government officials defend the move as a necessary measure against immigration fraud.
amharic: የሠራተኛ ማህበራት እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች በውጭ አገር ተማሪዎች፣ በልውውጥ ፕሮግራም ተሳታፊዎች እና በጋዜጠኞች ላይ አዲስ የቪዛ ገደብ የጣለውን የመንግስት ህግ በመቃወም ክስ መስርተዋል። አዲሱ ደንብ የተማሪዎችን እና የልውውጥ ጎብኝዎችን ቪዛ ቢበዛ ለአራት ዓመት፣ የጋዜጠኞችን ቪዛ ደግሞ እስከ 240 ቀናት ብቻ እንዲወሰን ያደርጋል። ከሳሾቹ ይህ ውሳኔ በትምህርት ተቋማት ላይ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስና ዓለም አቀፍ ተሰጥኦዎችን እንደሚያሳጣ ሲከራከሩ፣ የመንግስት አካላት ግን እርምጃው በስደት ስም የሚፈጸም ማጭበርበርን ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Gumiiwwan hojjettootaa fi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa falman, seerawwan mootummaa US haaraa barattoota alaa, namoota jijjiirraa barnootaaf dhufan, fi gaazexeessotaaf visa daangeessu mormuun himata bananiiru. Seerichi visa barattootaa fi namoota jijjiirraa waggaa afuriin, kan gaazexeessotaa immoo guyyaa 240tti akka daangeessu ajaja. Himattoonni seerichi barnootaa fi beekumsa addunyaa irratti miidhaa akka geessisu kan ibsan yoo ta'u, mootummaan immoo tarkaanfichi soba visa irratti raawwatamu ittisuuf murteessaa dha jedhaniiru.

title: UAE imposes indefinite trade embargo on Iran over alleged missile attacks
english: The United Arab Emirates has officially placed an indefinite trade and financial ban on Iran following allegations that Iranian forces launched ballistic missiles at the country. While the UAE claims these missiles were directed at maritime traffic and threatened regional security, Iran has strongly denied the accusations, calling the incident a false flag operation. This move marks a significant escalation in tensions as the ongoing conflict in the region shows no signs of resolution.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች የኢራን ኃይሎች በሀገሪቱ ላይ የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን ተኩሰዋል በሚል ክስ በኢራን ላይ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ የሚቆይ የንግድ እና የፋይናንስ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች። የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች ሚሳኤሎቹ የባህር ላይ ትራፊክን ኢላማ ያደረጉ እና ለክልሉ ደህንነት ስጋት የፈጠሩ ናቸው ብላለች። ኢራን በበኩሏ ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ ድርጊቱ የተቀነባበረ የሀሰት ክስ ነው ስትል አስተባብላለች።
oromo: Emirates Gamtooman (UAE) humnoonni Iraan biyyattii irratti xiyyaara kombii (missile) dhukaasaniiru jechuun, gabaa fi waliigaltee maallaqa irratti dhoorkaa yeroo hin murtoofne kaa’eera. UAE akka jedhitti xiyyaarotni kun daandii galaanaarratti miidhaa geessisuuf kan qajijfaman ta’uu ibsiteetti. Iraan garuu himata kana guutummaatti haaltu, gochi kun himata sobaa fi qindaa’aa ta’uu ibsiteetti.

title: US sanctions International Criminal Court’s president and top lawyer
english: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court's president, Tomoko Akane, and prosecutor Abdoulaye Seye. Washington claims these measures are intended to shield American citizens, despite the court never having pursued charges against any US nationals. This action follows the court's ongoing investigation into potential war crimes committed by Israel in Gaza.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ቶሞኮ አካኔ እና አቃቤ ህግ አብዱላዬ ሴይ ላይ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። ዋሽንግተን እርምጃውን የወሰደችው የአሜሪካ ዜጎችን ለመከላከል በሚል ቢሆንም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ እስካሁን በአሜሪካዊያን ላይ ክስ መስርቶ አያውቅም። ይህ ማዕቀብ የተጣለው ፍርድ ቤቱ እስራኤል በጋዛ የፈጸመቻቸውን የጦር ወንጀሎች እየመረመረ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa Tomoko Akane fi abukaattoo Abdoulaye Seye irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa fudhateera. Washington tarkaanfichi lammiilee Ameerikaa eeguuf kan yaadame ta'uu ibsite, garuu manni murtichaa kanaan dura namoota Ameerikaa irratti yakka tokkollee hin himanne. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame manni murtichaa yakka waraanaa Israa'el Gaazaatti raawwatte jedhame irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jirtu keessatti.

title: Trial begins that could force Meta to change Facebook and Instagram
english: A major trial is underway in California where Meta is being accused of intentionally making Facebook and Instagram addictive for younger users. A coalition representing over half of the United States is pushing for the company to pay significant financial penalties. They are also demanding major modifications to how these social media platforms function to better protect young people.
amharic: ሜታ የፌስቡክ እና የኢንስታግራም መተግበሪያዎችን በተለይም ለወጣቶች ሱስ በሚያስይዝ መልኩ ነድፏቸዋል በሚል በካሊፎርኒያ ክስ ተመስርቶበታል። ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑ የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ኩባንያው ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ካሳ እንዲከፍል እየጠየቁ ነው። በተጨማሪም ወጣቶችን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል መድረኮቹ የሚሰሩበት መንገድ እንዲቀየር አጥብቀው እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Meta dhaabbanni jedhamu Facebook fi Instagram fayyadamtoota dargaggootaa irratti akka hirkata uuman godhee qopheesseera jedhamee California keessatti himatameera. Mootummoonni naannolee Amerikaa gurguddoon walakkaa ol ta'an kaffaltii miidhaa guddaa akka kafalu gaafachaa jiru. Kana malees, dargaggoota eeguuf jecha haalli hojii marsariitiiwwan kanaa akka jijjiiramu dhaabbilee kunneen dirqisiisaa jiru.

title: Report: Syria denies security agreement with Israel after strike on airbase
english: The Syrian government has officially dismissed reports claiming they have a security agreement with Israel. A diplomatic source stated that Israel conducted an airstrike on a military airport despite being warned that the site was empty. Syria emphasized that it will not accept any deals that restrict its national sovereignty or military development.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግስት ከእስራኤል ጋር የፀጥታ ስምምነት አለ የሚለውን ወሬ በይፋ አስተባብሏል። አንድ ዲፕሎማቲክ ምንጭ እንደገለፀው እስራኤል በወታደራዊ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት የፈፀመችው ቦታው ባዶ እንደሆነ ከተነገራት በኋላ ነው። ሶሪያ የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ወይም ወታደራዊ እድገት የሚገድብ ምንም አይነት ስምምነት እንደማትቀበል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa waliigaltee nageenyaa Israa'el waliin qabaachuu isaa gabaasa dhihaate haaleera. Maddi tokko akka ibsutti, Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa waraanaa irratti haleellaa kan raawwatte iddoon sun duwwaa ta'uu akeekkachiifamtee booda dha. Suuriyaan aangoo fi guddina waraana ishee daangessu waliigaltee akkamiyyuu akka hin fudhanne ibsiteetti.

title: Blast at major Syrian pipeline halts gas flow, disrupts power generation
english: An explosion damaged a key gas pipeline in northeastern Syria, forcing a halt to gas production from the Al-Jabsah facility and causing power supply issues. Syrian officials believe the blast was a deliberate act of sabotage rather than an accident. Fortunately, no employees were injured during the incident, and authorities are currently investigating to find those responsible.
amharic: በሰሜን ምስራቅ ሶሪያ በሚገኝ ዋና የጋዝ መስመር ላይ የደረሰ ፍንዳታ የአል-ጃብሳ የጋዝ ማምረቻ ጣቢያ ስራ እንዲቆም እና የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል አቅርቦት እንዲስተጓጎል አድርጓል። የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ፍንዳታው በአደጋ ሳይሆን ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ የጥፋት ድርጊት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በክስተቱ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት ያልደረሰ ሲሆን፣ በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Siriyaa kaaba bahaatti ergaa guddaa kan ta'e diriirfama gaazii irratti dhukaatiin mudate, buufata gaazii Al-Jabsah irraa gadi lakkifamuun akka dhaabbatuu fi dhiyeessiin humna ibsaa akka addaan citu godheera. Abbootii taayitaa Siriyaatti, dhukaatiin kun balaa tasaa osoo hin taane, akeeka hamaa fi saboota kanaan kan raawwatame ta'uu amanu. Balaa kanaan hojjettoonni miidhamuu kan hin gabaafamne yoo ta'u, qaamoleen seeraa qorannoo geggeessuun qaama dhukaata kana dhaqqabsiise barbaadaa jiru.

title: Trump envoy 'deeply concerned' by Israeli strikes on Syrian air base
english: US special envoy for Syria, Tom Barrack, has criticized recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian military base. He labeled the attack an unnecessary escalation that threatens regional stability. Barrack argued that the Syrian government has not acted aggressively and has instead sought to avoid conflict with Israel.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሶሪያ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ቶም ባራክ በቅርቡ እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የፈጸመችውን የአየር ጥቃት ተችተዋል። ጥቃቱ የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል አላስፈላጊ እርምጃ ነው ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ባራክ የሶሪያ መንግስት ጠበኝነት እንዳላሳየ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር ግጭትን ለማስወገድ እንደሚፈልግ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ergamoonni addaa kan Yuunaayitid Isteetsifi Siiriyaa, Tom Baaraak, haleellaa qilleensaarraa kan Israa'el buufata waraanaa Siiriyaa irratti raawwatte ceeqa'aniiru. Tarkaanfichi tasgabbii naannichaa kan boreesuufi barbaachisaa kan hin taaneedha jedhaniiru. Baaraak, mootummaan Siiriyaa gocha akkasii kan hin raawwanneefi Israa'el waliin walitti bu'iinsa irraa of qusachaa akka jiru ibseera.

title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada and says countries close to a deal
english: President Donald Trump has temporarily halted the implementation of a 50% tariff on Canadian imports, citing that both nations are nearing a final trade agreement. This three-day extension provides negotiators time to finalize terms that could resolve ongoing disputes over goods like dairy, automobiles, and alcohol. Additionally, the potential deal may pave the way for the reactivation of the Keystone XL oil pipeline project.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ሊጥሉት የነበረውን የ50 በመቶ የታሪፍ ጭማሪ በሶስት ቀናት አዘግይተዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት በንግድ ስምምነት መደምደሚያ ላይ መድረሳቸውን ተከትሎ ይህ እገዳ የተወሰደ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በወተት፣ በመኪና እና በአልኮል ምርቶች ላይ የነበረውን አለመግባባት ለመፍታት ጊዜ ይሰጣል። በተጨማሪም ስምምነቱ ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት የቆመውን የኬይስቶን ኤክስኤል የነዳጅ መስመር ፕሮጀክት እንደገና ለመጀመር በር ሊከፍት ይችላል።
oromo: Preezidaant Doonaald Traamp oomishaalee Kaanaadaa irra ka'uuf karoorfame ture taariffii dhibbeentaa 50 ta'e guyyoota sadiif turchiisaniiru. Murteen kun kan fudhatame biyyoonni lameen walii galtee daldalaarratti xumura irra gahuu isaanii erga beeksisanii booda dha. Walii galtichi dhimmota akka aannan, konkolaataa fi alkoolii irratti wal dhabdee ture furuuf gargaara jedhamee kan eegamu yoo ta'u, piroojektii sagaroo boba'aa Keeyistoon Eks-El deebisanii jalqabuufis carraa uumuu danda'a.

title: Witness gets combative in Tupac murder trial - 'I don't want to send him to prison'
english: During the murder trial of Tupac Shakur, witness James McDonald gave a tense and combative testimony while refusing to identify Duane Davis as the person responsible. McDonald stated he was forced to testify under the threat of contempt, but he made it clear he did not want to be the reason Davis goes to prison. The trial continues thirty years after the rapper's death, highlighting the ongoing conflict between street codes and the legal process.

title: US, Canada reach trade deal to avert steep tariffs, Trump says
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States and Canada have successfully negotiated a trade agreement, preventing the implementation of 50 percent tariffs on Canadian goods. This deal was reached just before a midnight deadline, effectively halting taxes on items like electronics, machinery, and dairy products. Additionally, Trump suggested that the Keystone XL Pipeline project might be revived as part of the ongoing discussions.

oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaan fi Kanaadan walii galtee daldalaa irra gahuu isaanii fi gibiri dhibbeentaa 50 ta'e kan oomishaalee Kanaadaa irratti raawwatamuuf ture akka dhaabbate ibsaniiru. Walii galtichi yeroon gibirichi itti raawwatamuuf ture sa'aatii muraasa qofa osoo hin hafin kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, kunis meeshaalee elektirooniksii, maashinoota fi oomishaalee aannanii irratti qisaasama guddaa hambiseera. Kana malees, Traamp pirojektii bishaan daa'immanii ykn paayiplanii Keestoon Eks El (Keystone XL) deebi'ee jalqabamuu akka danda'u dubbataniiru.

title: US refineries taking in half of Venezuela’s oil output, official says
english: A senior US official reports that Venezuela is now exporting over 500,000 barrels of oil daily to US refineries, accounting for nearly half of its total production. This partnership utilizes US Gulf Coast facilities specifically designed to process Venezuela's heavy crude oil. Furthermore, the US is supporting this production by providing naphtha to help refine the Venezuelan oil, marking a significant increase in energy cooperation since the change in government.
amharic: አንድ ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣን እንደገለጹት ቬንዙዌላ አሁን ከጠቅላላ የነዳጅ ምርቷ ግማሽ ያህሉን ወይም ከ500,000 በርሜል በላይ በቀን ወደ አሜሪካ እየላከች ነው። ይህ የንግድ ግንኙነት የአሜሪካ የባህር ዳርቻ ማጣሪያዎች የቬንዙዌላን ከባድ የድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ለማቀነባበር ያላቸውን ልዩ አቅም ይጠቀማል። ከዚህም በላይ አሜሪካ የነዳጅ ምርቱን ለማገዝ ናፍታን ወደ ቬንዙዌላ በመላክ የሁለቱን ሀገራት የኢነርጂ ትብብር አጠናክራለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, Venezueelaan amma guyyaatti baarmila 500,000 ol ta'u gara Ameerikaatti erguu irra kan jirtu yoo ta'u, kunis oomisha ishee waligalaa keessaa walakkaa ol ta'a. Walitti dhufeenyi kun qulqulleeffattoota biyya Ameerikaa kanneen boba'aa ulfaataa Venezueelaa qulqulleessuuf mijatan fayyadama. Kana malees, Ameerikaan oomisha boba'aa kana saffisiisuuf naaftaa gara Venezueelaatti erguun gargaarsa gochuufi waliin hojii humna ibsaa cimsuu irra jirti.

title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
english: Recently dismissed Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has publicly called for the resumption of national elections, arguing that the country's democratic process must continue despite the ongoing war with Russia. Fedorov, who was removed from his position following internal tensions with military leadership, criticized the current government for corruption and a lack of transparency. While President Zelensky has not officially responded, the proposal highlights significant political friction within Ukraine regarding governance during wartime.
