oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Yukreen duraanii kan aangoo irraa kaafaman Mihayiloo Fedeerov, biyyattii keessatti waraanni yoo jiraateyyuu filannoon biyyoolessaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Fedeerov mootummaan amma jiru malaammaltummaafi jijjiirama dhabuu keessa akka jiru ibsuun, sirni dimokraasii Yukreen xumuraa hanga dhumaatti itti fufuu qaba jedhaniiru. Ajajoota waraanaa waliin wal-dhabdee uumameen aangoo irraa kan kaafaman Fedeerov, yaada kana dhiheessuun isaanii mootummaa Prezidaant Zeelenski keessatti dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa uumeera.

title: How Ebola became the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo’s history
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak ever, caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus. The crisis has resulted in over 2,300 deaths, surpassing all previous records, and is made more dangerous by the lack of specific vaccines or approved treatments. Ongoing regional conflict, community mistrust, and delayed detection of the virus have significantly hindered medical response efforts.

Waraanni naannichaa, amantii dhabuun hawaasaa fi yeroon dhibicha adda baasuun harkifachuu isaa dhibichi akka babal'atuu fi to'achuun akka ulfaatu taasiseera.

title: US ambassador to Israel calls settler violence ‘terror’
english: US Ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, has publicly labeled violence committed by Israeli settlers against Palestinians as acts of terror. This unusual criticism comes in response to an incident where settlers besieged the home of a Palestinian-American family in the West Bank village of Qusra. The statement highlights growing international concern regarding the safety of residents in the occupied territories.

title: Quebec separatist says no independence referendum while Trump in office
english: The leader of Quebec's separatist party, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, has announced that any referendum on independence will be delayed until Donald Trump is no longer US President. He believes that the current instability and unpredictability of American politics would negatively impact the quality of the independence debate. While he still intends to push for a vote if his party wins the upcoming election, it will not occur until after Trump's term ends in 2029.

title: Iran’s top security official ridicules Trump’s claims over Hormuz Strait
english: A senior Iranian security official has mocked Donald Trump for stating that the Strait of Hormuz is American territory. Mohsen Rezaei dismissed the claim as baseless, highlighting the massive geographic distance and the U.S. government's lack of control in the region. He declared that these comments signal the beginning of a new era where American influence in the Persian Gulf is fading.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia is undergoing a significant political shift as proposed constitutional reforms move away from old systems of shared power toward a model based on population size. Historically, Amhara political identity was deeply connected to the state’s center, but this new approach increasingly marginalizes that influence. As the government transitions to a system where representation is determined by demographic weight, the Amhara political establishment faces a critical challenge in redefining its future role within the nation.

oromo: Itoophiyaan jijjiirama siyaasaa gurguddaa keessa jirti; kunis sirna aango-qooddii duraanii dhiistee, bu'uura baay'ina ummataatiin hirmaannaa siyaasaa murteessuuf karoorfachuu ishee agarsiisa. title: Iran war live: Trump denies Iran talks, Tehran claims US ‘begging’
english: President Donald Trump has officially dismissed reports of any ongoing or planned negotiations between the United States and Iran. Conversely, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi asserts that Washington is desperately seeking talks on Iran's terms following the failure of their pressure tactics. Tensions remain high as the U.S. continues its naval blockade while trading conflicting claims with Tehran regarding their diplomatic status.

title: Al Jazeera reports from Indonesia’s quake zone, desperate for help
english: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake has struck Indonesia's Flores Island, resulting in the deaths of at least 70 people. Thousands of residents remain displaced and are currently in urgent need of assistance. Authorities are working quickly to distribute essential supplies like food, clean water, and medical resources to the hardest-hit areas.

oromo: Odola Flores kan Indoneesiyaatti lafti socho’uun hammaa 7.7 ga’u mudateen namoonni 70 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera. title: Turkey denies Israeli claims of posing a threat, says Netanyahu seeks to justify Syria strikes
english: Turkey has officially rejected Israeli claims that its military presence at a Syrian air base poses a security threat. Ankara argues that these allegations are merely an attempt by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to justify ongoing Israeli airstrikes against Syria. Turkey insists it remains committed to regional stability and urged Israel to stop its aggressive policies and follow international law.

title: Iran’s top negotiator says Hormuz Strait will remain closed until US abides by MoU
english: Iran's chief negotiator, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, has announced that the strategic Strait of Hormuz will continue to be blocked. He stated that the waterway will only reopen once the United States fulfills its obligations under a previous agreement. A primary demand from Tehran is for the U.S. to end its current naval blockade.

oromo: Hoggantoonni marii Iiraan Mohammad Baageer Gaalibaaf akka ibsanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz hanga Ameerikaan waadaa ishee seene guuttutti cufaa ta'ee akka turu ibsaniiru. Iiraan, Ameerikaan adabbii qarqara galaana ishee irratti gatee jirtu akka kaastu gaafachaa jirti. title: UAE condemns Israeli strikes on Syrian air base
english: The United Arab Emirates has officially denounced recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian airbase, labeling them a severe breach of international law and Syrian sovereignty. The UAE government argues that these military actions undermine regional stability and violate existing international agreements. Consequently, they are urging the global community to intervene immediately to prevent further escalation and ensure regional security.

title: Minnesota official sues Texas governor to force ICE agent’s extradition
english: Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison is suing Texas Governor Greg Abbott to compel the extradition of ICE agent Christian Castro, who faces charges for a shooting in Minnesota. Ellison argues that the Texas governor is illegally blocking the transfer of the officer to stand trial for allegedly wounding a man and providing false statements about the incident. This case highlights ongoing concerns regarding the credibility and conduct of federal agents during past immigration enforcement operations.

title: Iraq approves three-month mechanism for crude oil exports via local, international firms
english: The Iraqi government has authorized a new plan to export crude oil using both domestic and international companies. This strategy utilizes various export points to manage shipments effectively. These new contractual arrangements are scheduled to be in place for a three-month period beginning on September 1st.

title: Bolivia arrests political adviser to Latin American right-wingers
english: Bolivian authorities have arrested Fernando Cerimedo, a political consultant known for working with various right-wing leaders, on allegations of orchestrating a murder attempt. The arrest follows an attack on activist Nadia Beller, who was shot and robbed after opposing controversial government economic reforms linked to Cerimedo. Beller, who was previously in a relationship with Cerimedo, believes she was targeted for her political activism and for exposing high-level corruption.
amharic: የቦሊቪያ ባለስልጣናት ለተለያዩ የቀኝ ዘመም መሪዎች በፖለቲካ አማካሪነት ሲሰሩ የነበሩትን ፈርናንዶ ሴሪሜዶን የግድያ ሙከራ አቀነባብረዋል በሚል በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እስሩ የተፈጸመው ናዲያ ቤለር የተባለች አክቲቪስት ላይ ከተፈጸመ ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ ሲሆን፣ አክቲቪስቷ ከሴሪሜዶ ጋር በተያያዙ የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች ላይ በመቃወሟ ጥቃት እንደደረሰባት ገልጻለች። ከሴሪሜዶ ጋር የፍቅር ግንኙነት የነበራት ቤለር፣ በጥቃቱ የተረፈችው ስለሙስና እና ስለፖለቲካዊ ተጽእኖዎች በመናገሯ እንደሆነ ተናግራለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Boliviyaa gorsaa siyaasaa beekamaa fi hoggantoota mirgaa biyyoota Laatiin Ameerikaa waliin hojjetaa ture Fernando Cerimedo himannaa yaalii ajjeechaatiin hidheera.
